cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats on. I said that loose peg would matter; this is the outdoor part of our weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it before the tent fell.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the canvas. You lead us to the car; we've reached the travelling-light stage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's raining, and the car's a mile away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my coat as well. We were always going to finish on foot; I pointed that peg out before we unpacked.

reason: Make A adapt the return-to-car work and offer a coat in response to B practical hardship, while reusing the actual loose-peg warning as evidence of a planned ending.
